decision.next_gate: Create and double-seal the canonical M686-r6 CPU exact-load preflight, then independently review its preflight.json SHA and outer-seal-file SHA before any one-shot launch.

p2_findings.title: The post-preflight regression file is a future placeholder, not a currently executable test
p2_findings.evidence: The assigned preflight-test SHA compiles and statically checks the corrected full-seal ordering, but its hard-coded runner, contract and preflight roots still refer to an earlier not-yet-produced receipt set. The canonical M686-r6 preflight is correctly absent during this static hammer.
p2_findings.impact: It cannot serve as post-preflight evidence until its identities are updated after the authorized CPU-only run. It is not called by the runner and does not weaken the repaired pre-attempt gates.
p2_findings.repair: After CPU preflight creation, bind the final runner/contract/preflight receipt/outer roots, run the test, and obtain a separate independent preflight review before authorizing GPU one-shot consumption.

repair_evidence.pre_attempt_gate: A full member verification and outer-link verification now run after semantic parsing and before the external pair comparison; the pair gate is adjacent to attempt creation.
repair_evidence.tamper_attack: Changing a sealed member after the first verification makes the second SHA256SUMS check return 1, so attempt remains absent even though the receipt and outer-file SHA pair itself still matches.
repair_evidence.effective_backend: The runtime receipt candidate enumerates every module with a backend attribute and fails closed unless the exact inventory is Dropout:torch=49 and IFNode:torch=4. It separately requires PSN targets=0, ATLIFTernaryPSN=105, ATLIF backend attributes=0 and effective CuPy assignments=0.
repair_evidence.source_proof: ATLIFTernaryPSN source has no backend assignment and its forward contains torch.addmm; all relevant source files are explicit contract inputs with exact SHA binding. CuPy is labeled only as configured/resolved/installed.

passed_evidence.m685: review, manifest and outer-seal-file roots match and full double seal independently verifies
passed_evidence.native_tf32_controls: cudnn_allow_tf32=true with all other recorded controls fixed and live-rechecked after config/model, around every sample and before finalization
passed_evidence.s00_d0_sentinel: 839586 ones, 3768414 zeros, ad2251f... exact packed SHA
passed_evidence.freshness: M686-r6 preflight, output and attempt all absent
passed_evidence.fail_closed: D1 candidate scrub, staging, nested seal, exact binary and miter tests pass
